body.purpose: Running text, table cells, helper text. Max 65ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase key-value field labels in cards. The only uppercase treatment.

mono.purpose: All system/user-generated strings: slugs, URLs, IPs, timestamps.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: White card and table surfaces on Surface Subtle (#f9fafb). One layer only.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Button hover, input focus, row hover. Duration 150ms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action button. Used for form submit and post-creation CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #4f46e5; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4338ca; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f46e5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: URL input field on the create page.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; background: #ffffff; color: #111827; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7280; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #4f46e5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(79,70,229,0.3); } .ds-input.ds-input--error { border-color: #dc2626; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(220,38,38,0.3); }

components.name: Link Card
components.description: Key-value summary card for short link details (post-create and stats page).
components.html:
Short URL

https://sho.rt/abc123

Target URL

https://very-long-target-url.com/path/to/page
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-card__field { margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card__field:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; } .ds-card__label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #6b7280; margin: 0 0 4px 0; } .ds-card__value { font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #111827; margin: 0; word-break: break-all; } .ds-card__value--mono { font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', Menlo, monospace; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Primary data container for visit logs and top-links report.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); overflow: hidden; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-table thead tr { background: #f9fafb; } .ds-table th { padding: 12px 16px; text-align: left; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #4b5563; } .ds-table td { padding: 12px 16px; color: #374151; border-top: 1px solid #f3f4f6; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover td { background: #f9fafb; } .ds-table__right { text-align: right; } .ds-table__mono { font-family: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', Menlo, monospace; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Top navigation. Two links, always visible.
components.css: .ds-nav { background: #ffffff; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; } .ds-nav__inner { max-width: 48rem; margin: 0 auto; padding: 12px 16px; display: flex; gap: 24px; } .ds-nav__link { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #4f46e5; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav__link:hover { color: #4338ca; }

components.name: Error Message
components.css: .ds-field-error { font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: #dc2626; margin: 4px 0 0 0; }

narrative.overview:
This is a precision instrument. Every screen exists to complete one job and move the user on. The aesthetic draws from data-focused products like CoinGecko — white surfaces, subtle gray structure, one restrained accent color used only where action is required. Nothing competes for attention.

The system is light-mode only, built for use at any hour in any context. Data — slugs, URLs, click counts, geolocations — is presented in monospace or tight tabular layouts so it reads as factual, not styled.

What this system explicitly rejects: crypto-neon aesthetics, gradient text, glassmorphism as decoration, generic SaaS-blue hero metrics, side-stripe accents on cards.
keyCharacteristics: White-surface, gray-structure layout — depth through borders, not shadows
Single accent color used only on interactive elements
Monospace for all user-generated or system-generated strings
Labels in uppercase tracking — the only typographic texture permitted
Tables as the primary data container

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue (#4f46e5) appears only on interactive elements. Never as a background tint, decorative stripe, or emphasis on static text.

rules.name: The No-Tint Rule
rules.body: Cards use Surface White (#ffffff). Do not add blue or gray tints to card backgrounds.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Data Rule
rules.body: Any string the system generated or the user submitted renders in the mono stack. UI labels render in system sans.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No element receives a shadow unless it is a white card or table container on a gray background.

dos: Use Signal Blue (#4f46e5) exclusively on interactive elements.
Use monospace for every system-generated or user-submitted string.
Render table headers in uppercase with 0.05em letter-spacing.
Use Border Default (#e5e7eb) as the primary structural element.
Use Surface Subtle (#f9fafb) as the page background.
donts: Don't use neon colors, gradient text, or glassmorphism.
Don't add a colored side-stripe (border-left > 1px) to cards or alerts.
Don't use Signal Blue as a background tint or emphasis on static text.
Don't use more than Ambient Low shadow on any element.
Don't use uppercase or letter-spacing outside of key-value field labels.
Don't add decorative empty-state illustrations. A sentence in Text Muted is enough.
